S.FORM: tiku Matu'uwal na' Itaal ga, kumal naha' nanak maha' ita' ga Matu'uwal, ani pinatiqan ini ga pinsibaq na' nanabakis,
tiku Matu'uwal na' Itaal ga, kumal naha' nanak maha' ita' ga Matu'uwal, ani pinatiqan ini ga pinsibaq na' nanabakis,
S.PHON: tiku matuʔuwal naʔ itaal ɣa kumal naħaʔ nanak maħaʔ itaʔ ɣa matuʔuwal ani pinatiqan ini ɣa pin[s|ɕ]iβaq naʔ nanaβaki[s|ɕ]
S.TRANSL: 汶水泰雅人（族人自稱Matu’uwal），不管是文獻記載或耆老口述

S.FORM: kumal ku' Itaal i' Tayan maha', minukahul i' Papakwaqa ku' Itaal.
kumal ku' Itaal i' Tayan maha', minukahul i' Papakwaqa ku' Itaal.
S.PHON: kumal kuʔ itaal iʔ tajan maħaʔ minukaħul iʔ papakwaqa kuʔ itaal
S.TRANSL: 泰安鄉大多數的泰雅族人認為，大霸尖山是泰雅族的起源地，

S.FORM: ini packa' cku' kinal nku' qalaqalang maha', Itaal ga, minukahul i' Nantosyen i' Renngay Go i' Pinsbakan maha' kumal ku' Itaal.
ini packa' cku' kinal nku' qalaqalang maha', Itaal ga, minukahul i' Nantosyen i' Renngay Go i' Pinsbakan maha' kumal ku' Itaal.
S.PHON: ini pa[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ kinal nkuʔ qalaqalaŋ maħaʔ itaal ɣa minukaħul iʔ nanto[s|ɕ]jen iʔ renŋaj ɣo iʔ pin[s|ɕ]βakan maħaʔ kumal kuʔ itaal
S.TRANSL: 與泰雅族各部落認為，泰雅族的起源地在南投縣仁愛鄉賓斯博干（pinsbkan）的口述有很大的出入，

S.FORM: asikina ga kuruma' ka Itaal ka Matu'uwal ga, sinnawawun naha' maha', tiku Matu'uwal ga, asi glug nku' luliyung na' Holongsi ru tayhuk i' cku' raya' niya' ka luliyung na' Mayri' la.
asikina ga kuruma' ka Itaal ka Matu'uwal ga, sinnawawun naha' maha', tiku Matu'uwal ga, asi glug nku' luliyung na' Holongsi ru tayhuk i' cku' raya' niya' ka luliyung na' Mayri' la.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]ikina ɣa kurumaʔ ka itaal ka matuʔuwal ɣa [s|ɕ]innawawun naħaʔ maħaʔ tiku matuʔuwal ɣa a[s|ɕ]i ɣluɣ nkuʔ lulijuŋ naʔ ħoloŋ[s|ɕ]i ru tajħuk iʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ rajaʔ nijaʔ ka lulijuŋ naʔ majriʔ la
S.TRANSL: 但多數的汶水人更相信，汶水人是沿著後龍溪一路來到其上游汶水溪，

S.FORM: babaw niya'la ga, tumimu' i' Cingancun i' Mabawtu'an, Paquwali' i' Mabawkian ru Cinsuwei i' Tabilas.
babaw niya'la ga, tumimu' i' Cingancun i' Mabawtu'an, Paquwali' i' Mabawkian ru Cinsuwei i' Tabilas.
S.PHON: βaβaw nijaʔla ɣa tumimuʔ iʔ [ʦ|ʨ]iŋan[ʦ|ʨ]un iʔ maβawtuʔan paquwaliʔ iʔ maβawkian ru [ʦ|ʨ]in[s|ɕ]uwei iʔ taβila[s|ɕ]
S.TRANSL: 在清安村大坪部落（Mabawtu’an），八卦村八卦部落（Mabawkian），錦水村的圓墩部落蓋房子。

S.FORM: Mayrinax ga siniralu' nku' kumal cu' kai' na' squliq. Matu'uwal ga siniralu' nku' Itaal i' Tabilas.
Mayrinax ga siniralu' nku' kumal cu' kai' na' squliq. Matu'uwal ga siniralu' nku' Itaal i' Tabilas.
S.PHON: majrinax ɣa [s|ɕ]iniraluʔ nkuʔ kumal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaiʔ naʔ [s|ɕ]quliq matuʔuwal ɣa [s|ɕ]iniraluʔ nkuʔ itaal iʔ taβila[s|ɕ]
S.TRANSL: Mayrinax 是別族（賽考利克）對汶水泰雅人的稱呼，Matu’uwal 是汶水泰雅人的自稱，

S.FORM: ani ini packa' ku' sinralu'an ga macka' i' Itaal i' Tabilas kahabag.
ani ini packa' ku' sinralu'an ga macka' i' Itaal i' Tabilas kahabag.
S.PHON: ani ini pa[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ kuʔ [s|ɕ]inraluʔan ɣa ma[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ iʔ itaal iʔ taβila[s|ɕ] kaħaβaɣ
S.TRANSL: 儘管稱呼不同，但都是指稱說汶水泰雅語的泰雅族人，

S.FORM: ralu' nku' inuwahan na' Mayrinax ru Matu'uwal. tiku nanabakis nku' Tabilas ga ini naha' baqibaqi cuqaang la.
ralu' nku' inuwahan na' Mayrinax ru Matu'uwal. tiku nanabakis nku' Tabilas ga ini naha' baqibaqi cuqaang la.
S.PHON: raluʔ nkuʔ inuwaħan naʔ majrinax ru matuʔuwal tiku nanaβaki[s|ɕ] nkuʔ taβila[s|ɕ] ɣa ini naħaʔ βaqiβaqi [ʦ|ʨ]uqaaŋ la
S.TRANSL: mayrinax 與 matu’uwal 名稱真正的由來，老一輩的汶水泰雅族人早已不清楚，

S.FORM: kumal Abisang maha', maki runi ku' Gipun ga siniralu' naha' ku' luliyung ga Mayri' san niya'.
kumal Abisang maha', maki runi ku' Gipun ga siniralu' naha' ku' luliyung ga Mayri' san niya'.
S.PHON: kumal aβi[s|ɕ]aŋ maħaʔ maki runi kuʔ ɣipun ɣa [s|ɕ]iniraluʔ naħaʔ kuʔ lulijuŋ ɣa majriʔ [s|ɕ]an nijaʔ
S.TRANSL: 但根據發音人湯元基先生的說法mayri’是汶水泰雅人早期對汶水溪的稱呼，

S.FORM: babaw niya' ga rasun nku' Gipun ku' minakiya i' Babuan cu' Para ka kinahakul ru siralu'an naha' ku' miniyani i' runi maha' Mayrinax. kumal cu' kai' na' Matu'uwal ga yani ku' Cinswei i' Tabilas, Paquwali' i' Mabawkian ru Cingan i' Mabawtuan

babaw niya' ga rasun nku' Gipun ku' minakiya i' Babuan cu' Para ka kinahakul ru siralu'an naha' ku' miniyani i' runi maha' Mayrinax. kumal cu' kai' na' Matu'uwal ga yani ku' Cinswei i' Tabilas, Paquwali' i' Mabawkian ru Cingan i' Mabawtuan
S.PHON: βaβaw nijaʔ ɣa ra[s|ɕ]un nkuʔ ɣipun kuʔ minakija iʔ βaβuan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ para ka kinaħakul ru [s|ɕ]iraluʔan naħaʔ kuʔ minijani iʔ runi maħaʔ majrinax kumal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaiʔ naʔ matuʔuwal ɣa jani kuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]in[s|ɕ]wei iʔ taβila[s|ɕ] paquwaliʔ iʔ maβawkian ru [ʦ|ʨ]iŋan iʔ maβawtuan
S.TRANSL: 後來日本人迫使原本住在Babuan cu’ Para移居到錦水村周邊部落的Kinahakul 用來稱呼住在汶水溪旁的圓墩部落的汶水人為Mayrinax，

S.FORM: siqunun ga kii' mamatu' kabhul cu' rawiq maha' kumal ku' Tayan Go.
siqunun ga kii' mamatu' kabhul cu' rawiq maha' kumal ku' Tayan Go.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iqunun ɣa kiiʔ mamatuʔ kaβħul [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ rawiq maħaʔ kumal kuʔ tajan ɣo
S.TRANSL: 目前說汶水泰雅語的Matu’uwal 人

S.FORM: kumal ku' Sebu' na' Taywan maha' i' kabhul ru qutux cu' kaal. rawiq na' Itaal kahabag ga mamaspat cu' mang ru mamaspat cu' seng.
kumal ku' Sebu' na' Taywan maha' i' kabhul ru qutux cu' kaal. rawiq na' Itaal kahabag ga mamaspat cu' mang ru mamaspat cu' seng.
S.PHON: kumal kuʔ [s|ɕ]eβuʔ naʔ tajwan maħaʔ iʔ kaβħul ru qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaal rawiq naʔ itaal kaħaβaɣ ɣa mama[s|ɕ]pat [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ maŋ ru mama[s|ɕ]pat [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ [s|ɕ]eŋ
S.TRANSL: 根據台灣政府101年的說法，全泰雅族人口約8萬8千人，

S.FORM: payux tikay hayhay ku' rawiq na' kakanayril cku' mamaliku. nanabakis na' Itaal ga ini kapayux.
payux tikay hayhay ku' rawiq na' kakanayril cku' mamaliku. nanabakis na' Itaal ga ini kapayux.
S.PHON: pajux tikaj ħajħaj kuʔ rawiq naʔ kakanajril [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ mamaliku nanaβaki[s|ɕ] naʔ itaal ɣa ini kapajux
S.TRANSL: 女性人口比男性人口多，老年人口不多，

S.FORM: ulu'laqi' na' kinabahan na' Matu'uwal ga aruwa' 'i' masiglug ki' siputu', hulu' ru tuiya'. yani ku' araruwa' tikay ku' rawiq na' Matu'uwal i' sawni.
ulu'laqi' na' kinabahan na' Matu'uwal ga aruwa' 'i' masiglug ki' siputu', hulu' ru tuiya'. yani ku' araruwa' tikay ku' rawiq na' Matu'uwal i' sawni.
S.PHON: uluʔlaqiʔ naʔ kinaβaħan naʔ matuʔuwal ɣa aruwaʔ ʔiʔ ma[s|ɕ]iɣluɣ kiʔ [s|ɕ]iputuʔ ħuluʔ ru tuijaʔ jani kuʔ araruwaʔ tikaj kuʔ rawiq naʔ matuʔuwal iʔ [s|ɕ]awni
S.TRANSL: 年輕人與外族通婚導致人口減少，因此泰雅族的人口至今成長不多。

S.FORM: wawaw na' rawiq na' Matu'uwal ga, macka' ki' kinal na' Sebu' na' Taywan ku' wawaw na' rawiq ka hani.
wawaw na' rawiq na' Matu'uwal ga, macka' ki' kinal na' Sebu' na' Taywan ku' wawaw na' rawiq ka hani.
S.PHON: wawaw naʔ rawiq naʔ matuʔuwal ɣa ma[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ kiʔ kinal naʔ [s|ɕ]eβuʔ naʔ tajwan kuʔ wawaw naʔ rawiq ka ħani
S.TRANSL: 汶水泰雅的人口很接近台灣政府的說法。

S.FORM: tiku kumal cu' kai' na' Matu'uwal ga yani ku' kiya' cku' Tabilas i' Cinswei, kii' kiya' humaynas cu' tugal cu' kabhul masiqaang ku' Matu'uwal.
tiku kumal cu' kai' na' Matu'uwal ga yani ku' kiya' cku' Tabilas i' Cinswei, kii' kiya' humaynas cu' tugal cu' kabhul masiqaang ku' Matu'uwal.
S.PHON: tiku kumal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaiʔ naʔ matuʔuwal ɣa jani kuʔ kijaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ taβila[s|ɕ] iʔ [ʦ|ʨ]in[s|ɕ]wei kiiʔ kijaʔ ħumajna[s|ɕ] [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ tuɣal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaβħul ma[s|ɕ]iqaaŋ kuʔ matuʔuwal
S.TRANSL: 汶水泰雅人住在錦水村的圓墩部落人口大約300人，

S.FORM: Mabawkian i' Paquwli' ga, qutux cu' kabhul ru mapitu kimnamalapgan ru masiqaang ku' Matu'uwal.
Mabawkian i' Paquwli' ga, qutux cu' kabhul ru mapitu kimnamalapgan ru masiqaang ku' Matu'uwal.
S.PHON: maβawkian iʔ paquwliʔ ɣa qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaβħul ru mapitu kimnamalapɣan ru ma[s|ɕ]iqaaŋ kuʔ matuʔuwal
S.TRANSL: 八卦村的八卦部落人口約170人，

S.FORM: tiku kiya' cku' Mabawtuan i' Cingan ga, kii' qutux cu' kabhul ru maymal kimnamalapgan ru masiqaang ku' Matu'uwal.
tiku kiya' cku' Mabawtuan i' Cingan ga, kii' qutux cu' kabhul ru maymal kimnamalapgan ru masiqaang ku' Matu'uwal.
S.PHON: tiku kijaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ maβawtuan iʔ [ʦ|ʨ]iŋan ɣa kiiʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaβħul ru majmal kimnamalapɣan ru ma[s|ɕ]iqaaŋ kuʔ matuʔuwal
S.TRANSL: 清安村大坪部落人口則有150人左右，

S.FORM: siqunun kahabag ku' tugal ka tinqalangan na' Matu'uwal ga, kii' mamatu' cu' kabhul cu' rawiq.
siqunun kahabag ku' tugal ka tinqalangan na' Matu'uwal ga, kii' mamatu' cu' kabhul cu' rawiq.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iqunun kaħaβaɣ kuʔ tuɣal ka tinqalaŋan naʔ matuʔuwal ɣa kiiʔ mamatuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaβħul [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ rawiq
S.TRANSL: 三個部落合起來共計超過600人。

S.FORM: tinqalangan na' Tabilas i' Cinswei ga ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga, matkaqutux cu' imuwaag ga Huwang, Lin, Lyu, Bu ru Ye, Tien, Tang, Cong ru Li.
tinqalangan na' Tabilas i' Cinswei ga ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga, matkaqutux cu' imuwaag ga Huwang, Lin, Lyu, Bu ru Ye, Tien, Tang, Cong ru Li.
S.PHON: tinqalaŋan naʔ taβila[s|ɕ] iʔ [ʦ|ʨ]in[s|ɕ]wei ɣa ka qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa matkaqutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa ħuwaŋ lin lju βu ru je tien taŋ [ʦ|ʨ]oŋ ru li
S.TRANSL: 在錦水村的圓墩部落部的家族結構以黃姓、林姓、劉姓、葉姓、傅姓、田姓，湯姓、鍾姓、李姓等，

S.FORM: tinqalangan na' Mabawkian i' Paquwli' ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga, matkaqutux cu' imuwaag ga Lin, Tien, Co, Huwang ru Li.
tinqalangan na' Mabawkian i' Paquwli' ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga, matkaqutux cu' imuwaag ga Lin, Tien, Co, Huwang ru Li.
S.PHON: tinqalaŋan naʔ maβawkian iʔ paquwliʔ ka qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa matkaqutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa lin tien [ʦ|ʨ]o ħuwaŋ ru li
S.TRANSL: 八卦村的八卦部落，以林姓、田姓、周姓、黃姓，李姓等，

S.FORM: tinqalangan na' Mabawtuan i' Cingan ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga, matkaqutux cu' imuwaag ga Lyu, Long, Bong, Lin.
tinqalangan na' Mabawtuan i' Cingan ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga, matkaqutux cu' imuwaag ga Lyu, Long, Bong, Lin.
S.PHON: tinqalaŋan naʔ maβawtuan iʔ [ʦ|ʨ]iŋan ka qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa matkaqutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa lju loŋ βoŋ lin
S.TRANSL: 其次是清安村的大坪部落，以劉姓、龍姓、馮姓、林姓等成為一個宗族，

S.FORM: muwani ku' pinatasan na' Tayan Go i' 2008 cu' kaal.
muwani ku' pinatasan na' Tayan Go i' 2008 cu' kaal.
S.PHON: muwani kuʔ pinata[s|ɕ]an naʔ tajan ɣo iʔ **** [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaal
S.TRANSL: 人口大約六百人左右，《泰安鄉志》2008如此說。

S.FORM: san maha' kai' nku' Matu'uwal ga masasawbih cku' kai' na' c'uli'. kumal ku'mamaliku ini ga kakanayril ga ini packa' ku' kakalan naha'.
san maha' kai' nku' Matu'uwal ga masasawbih cku' kai' na' c'uli'. kumal ku'mamaliku ini ga kakanayril ga ini packa' ku' kakalan naha'.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]an maħaʔ kaiʔ nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa ma[s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]awβiħ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ kaiʔ naʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ʔuliʔ kumal kuʔmamaliku ini ɣa kakanajril ɣa ini pa[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ kuʔ kakalan naħaʔ
S.TRANSL: 汶水泰雅語屬於泰雅語的澤傲利方言群，會因為說話者為男性或女性而使用不同的語言型態，

S.FORM: kahuy san na' kakanayril, kahuniq san na' mamaliku.
kahuy san na' kakanayril, kahuniq san na' mamaliku.
S.PHON: kaħuj [s|ɕ]an naʔ kakanajril kaħuniq [s|ɕ]an naʔ mamaliku
S.TRANSL: 例如：「樹木」女性會說（kahuy），男性會說（kahuniq），

S.FORM: imu san na' kakanayril ga, imuwaag san na' mamaliku.
imu san na' kakanayril ga, imuwaag san na' mamaliku.
S.PHON: imu [s|ɕ]an naʔ kakanajril ɣa imuwaaɣ [s|ɕ]an naʔ mamaliku
S.TRANSL: 例如：「房子」女性會說（imu），男性會說（imuwaag）……。

S.FORM: tiku mapitu' kinamlapgan ka nanabakis nku' Matu'uwal ga ini qabaq cuqaang 'i' kumal cu' kai' na' mamaliku ini ga kai' na' kakanayril.
tiku mapitu' kinamlapgan ka nanabakis nku' Matu'uwal ga ini qabaq cuqaang 'i' kumal cu' kai' na' mamaliku ini ga kai' na' kakanayril.
S.PHON: tiku mapituʔ kinamlapɣan ka nanaβaki[s|ɕ] nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa ini qaβaq [ʦ|ʨ]uqaaŋ ʔiʔ kumal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaiʔ naʔ mamaliku ini ɣa kaiʔ naʔ kakanajril
S.TRANSL: 現在七十歲左右的汶水耆老不會因為男女性別差異而使用不同的語言型態，

S.FORM: kinabahan na' ulu'laqi' i' sawni ga, ini qabaq cubalay 'i' kumal la ku' kai' nku' Matu'uwal. kai' nku' Matu'uwal ga,
kinabahan na' ulu'laqi' i' sawni ga, ini qabaq cubalay 'i' kumal la ku' kai' nku' Matu'uwal. kai' nku' Matu'uwal ga,
S.PHON: kinaβaħan naʔ uluʔlaqiʔ iʔ [s|ɕ]awni ɣa ini qaβaq [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj ʔiʔ kumal la kuʔ kaiʔ nkuʔ matuʔuwal kaiʔ nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa
S.TRANSL: 而年輕人已不會使用自己的語言了，

S.FORM: kiya' na ku' sinubilan cu' hanang ru kai' na' nanabakis cucunga' kiya' wiy ku' mananananaq ru kinabalaiq ka kai' nku' Matu'uwal i' sawni.
kiya' na ku' sinubilan cu' hanang ru kai' na' nanabakis cucunga' kiya' wiy ku' mananananaq ru kinabalaiq ka kai' nku' Matu'uwal i' sawni.
S.PHON: kijaʔ na kuʔ [s|ɕ]inuβilan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ ħanaŋ ru kaiʔ naʔ nanaβaki[s|ɕ] [ʦ|ʨ]u[ʦ|ʨ]uŋaʔ kijaʔ wij kuʔ mananananaq ru kinaβalaiq ka kaiʔ nkuʔ matuʔuwal iʔ [s|ɕ]awni
S.TRANSL: 汶水泰雅語保存較古老的音韻與構詞現象，又因為汶水泰雅語語言地位之特殊性及重要性，

S.FORM: tiku magalpug cu' kaal ka aruwa' ka sawni ga, payux ku' papasibaq 'i' muwah 'i' makibaq cku' kai' nku' Matu'uwal.
tiku magalpug cu' kaal ka aruwa' ka sawni ga, payux ku' papasibaq 'i' muwah 'i' makibaq cku' kai' nku' Matu'uwal.
S.PHON: tiku maɣalpuɣ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaal ka aruwaʔ ka [s|ɕ]awni ɣa pajux kuʔ papa[s|ɕ]iβaq ʔiʔ muwaħ ʔiʔ makiβaq [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ kaiʔ nkuʔ matuʔuwal
S.TRANSL: 數十年來學界將本語言作為研究的對象與題材。

S.FORM: talan na' nanabakis ku' ulu'laqi' na' kinabahan ka ini qabaq 'i' kumal cu' kai' nku' Matu'uwal.
talan na' nanabakis ku' ulu'laqi' na' kinabahan ka ini qabaq 'i' kumal cu' kai' nku' Matu'uwal.
S.PHON: talan naʔ nanaβaki[s|ɕ] kuʔ uluʔlaqiʔ naʔ kinaβaħan ka ini qaβaq ʔiʔ kumal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaiʔ nkuʔ matuʔuwal
S.TRANSL: 眼看年輕人已不會說自己的語言，

S.FORM: yani cubalay 'i' masa'utu' 'i' magluglug 'i' matas cu' kai' nku' Matu'uwal ku' nanabakis. mana'aring 'i' pasibaq cu' ulu'laqi' na' kinabahan ku' pinatas naha'.

S.FORM: macka' cku' qawnan. qutuxqutux ka tinqalangan ga kiya' a' luliyung naha' cu' qulih nanaq ru asi baqibaqi a' qays naha'.

S.PHON: ma[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ qawnan qutuxqutux ka tinqalaŋan ɣa kijaʔ aʔ lulijuŋ naħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ nanaq ru a[s|ɕ]i βaqiβaqi aʔ qaj[s|ɕ] naħaʔ
S.TRANSL: 就如同獵場一樣，各部落皆有自己的魚場且界線明顯，

S.FORM: nanaq kiya' ku' minagawng na'qutuxqutux ka tinqalangan. qumlih ga,
nanaq kiya' ku' minagawng na'qutuxqutux ka tinqalangan. qumlih ga,
S.PHON: nanaq kijaʔ kuʔ minaɣawŋ naʔqutuxqutux ka tinqalaŋan qumliħ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 甚至每一條溪分屬不同部落是不成文的規定，

S.FORM: kiya' ku' musa' nanaq ru qutux cu' glug asikina ga payux tikay ku' qutux cu' glug 'i' musa' 'i' rumkap cu' qulih.
kiya' ku' musa' nanaq ru qutux cu' glug asikina ga payux tikay ku' qutux cu' glug 'i' musa' 'i' rumkap cu' qulih.
S.PHON: kijaʔ kuʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ nanaq ru qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ ɣluɣ a[s|ɕ]ikina ɣa pajux tikaj kuʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ ɣluɣ ʔiʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ rumkap [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ
S.TRANSL: 捕魚有個人與團體兩種，但以團體補魚居多，

S.FORM: yani cubalay ku' waw na' tinqalangan ka hani. qutuxqutux cu' kaal ka gabagan ga, masa'utu' i' luliyungng ku' Itaal.
yani cubalay ku' waw na' tinqalangan ka hani. qutuxqutux cu' kaal ka gabagan ga, masa'utu' i' luliyungng ku' Itaal.
S.PHON: jani [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj kuʔ waw naʔ tinqalaŋan ka ħani qutuxqutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaal ka ɣaβaɣan ɣa ma[s|ɕ]aʔutuʔ iʔ lulijuŋŋ kuʔ itaal
S.TRANSL: 是部落的重要活動之一，每年夏季族人匯聚在河邊，

S.FORM: tuba'an naha' na' tatuba' ku' qulih ru sipaqasug naha' cku' minuwah ka qutuxqutux ka itaal.
tuba'an naha' na' tatuba' ku' qulih ru sipaqasug naha' cku' minuwah ka qutuxqutux ka itaal.
S.PHON: tuβaʔan naħaʔ naʔ tatuβaʔ kuʔ quliħ ru [s|ɕ]ipaqa[s|ɕ]uɣ naħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ minuwaħ ka qutuxqutux ka itaal
S.TRANSL: 用魚藤汁麻醉魚類，參加的人都可以分到魚貨。

S.FORM: kiya' ku' a'aalan cu' qulih inha' ga, tapanaq, tataku', kawbu', pa' na' kawbu' ru naip.
kiya' ku' a'aalan cu' qulih inha' ga, tapanaq, tataku', kawbu', pa' na' kawbu' ru naip.
S.PHON: kijaʔ kuʔ aʔaalan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ inħaʔ ɣa tapanaq tatakuʔ kawβuʔ paʔ naʔ kawβuʔ ru naip
S.TRANSL: 捕魚的魚具有魚叉、魚網、魚荃、架網與釣鉤等，

S.FORM: kiya' ku' rumkap cu' qulih ga, cumbu' na' tapanaq cu' qulih, humawb cu' qulih, umayng cu' qulih, tumuba' cu' qulih ru qumlih.
kiya' ku' rumkap cu' qulih ga, cumbu' na' tapanaq cu' qulih, humawb cu' qulih, umayng cu' qulih, tumuba' cu' qulih ru qumlih.
S.PHON: kijaʔ kuʔ rumkap [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]umβuʔ naʔ tapanaq [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ ħumawβ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ umajŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ tumuβaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ ru qumliħ
S.TRANSL: 至於補魚的方法則有射魚、叉魚、網魚、釣魚、毒魚和堰魚，

S.FORM: tiku tumuba' cu' qulih na' 'i' hiya' ga, lumamu' cu' tatuba i' ragiyax, siagal naha' cu' batunux ru paqupaqun han ru buqan cku' raya' na' luliyung.
tiku tumuba' cu' qulih na' 'i' hiya' ga, lumamu' cu' tatuba i' ragiyax, siagal naha' cu' batunux ru paqupaqun han ru buqan cku' raya' na' luliyung.
S.PHON: tiku tumuβaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ naʔ ʔiʔ ħijaʔ ɣa lumamuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ tatuβa iʔ raɣijax [s|ɕ]iaɣal naħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βatunux ru paqupaqun ħan ru βuqan [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ rajaʔ naʔ lulijuŋ
S.TRANSL: 其中毒魚是將山上採集的毒藤用石頭打碎放入河中上游，待魚被麻醉浮出水面後，

S.FORM: lawaun tikay ru tatalan ku' tubaan ka qulih 'i' masqaqali' cku' luliyung.
lawaun tikay ru tatalan ku' tubaan ka qulih 'i' masqaqali' cku' luliyung.
S.PHON: lawaun tikaj ru tatalan kuʔ tuβaan ka quliħ ʔiʔ ma[s|ɕ]qaqaliʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ lulijuŋ
S.TRANSL: 族人在下游撈魚，

S.FORM: umayng cu' qulih ru lumamu' cu' qulih i' kahu' na' luliyung. ma'aping ku' qusiya' la ga, mana'aring 'i' qumlih la. haga'an cu' batunux han ru sukuan cu' abag la ru sukuan cu' bunaqi' la.
umayng cu' qulih ru lumamu' cu' qulih i' kahu' na' luliyung. ma'aping ku' qusiya' la ga, mana'aring 'i' qumlih la. haga'an cu' batunux han ru sukuan cu' abag la ru sukuan cu' bunaqi' la.
S.PHON: umajŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ ru lumamuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ iʔ kaħuʔ naʔ lulijuŋ maʔapiŋ kuʔ qu[s|ɕ]ijaʔ la ɣa manaʔariŋ ʔiʔ qumliħ la ħaɣaʔan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βatunux ħan ru [s|ɕ]ukuan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ aβaɣ la ru [s|ɕ]ukuan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βunaqiʔ la
S.TRANSL: 而堰魚乃利用枯水季節， 先以石頭築堰再放入葉子和泥沙，

S.FORM: papuusalun ca buwinah ku' qusiya' la ru sukuan cu' kawbu' na' Itaal 'i' makahu' niya' la.
papuusalun ca buwinah ku' qusiya' la ru sukuan cu' kawbu' na' Itaal 'i' makahu' niya' la.
S.PHON: papuu[s|ɕ]alun [ʦ|ʨ]a βuwinaħ kuʔ qu[s|ɕ]ijaʔ la ru [s|ɕ]ukuan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kawβuʔ naʔ itaal ʔiʔ makaħuʔ nijaʔ la
S.TRANSL: 泰雅族人將魚筌放置在河的上游，引水導魚，在築堰的下游放魚筌接魚

S.FORM: ini packa ku' kaal ga ini pack ku' rumkap cu' qulih. tumuba cu' qulih ga tumuba' i' qamisan ka tikay ka qusiya'.
ini packa ku' kaal ga ini pack ku' rumkap cu' qulih. tumuba cu' qulih ga tumuba' i' qamisan ka tikay ka qusiya'.
S.PHON: ini pa[ʦ|ʨ]ka kuʔ kaal ɣa ini pa[ʦ|ʨ]k kuʔ rumkap [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ tumuβa [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ ɣa tumuβaʔ iʔ qami[s|ɕ]an ka tikaj ka qu[s|ɕ]ijaʔ
S.TRANSL: 補魚的方法因季節而不同，毒魚和堰魚約在秋冬枯水期時進行，

S.FORM: tumaku' cu' qulih ru panaip ga musa' 'i' rahwal a' qusiya'.
tumaku' cu' qulih ru panaip ga musa' 'i' rahwal a' qusiya'.
S.PHON: tumakuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ quliħ ru panaip ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ raħwal aʔ qu[s|ɕ]ijaʔ
S.TRANSL: 網魚和釣魚則在河水較充沛時進行，

S.FORM: ' i' minuwah ku' rahuwal ka qwalax ru bayhu ka tugal ini ga imagal cu' ri'ax ga, balaiq cubalay 'i' kumari'.
' i' minuwah ku' rahuwal ka qwalax ru bayhu ka tugal ini ga imagal cu' ri'ax ga, balaiq cubalay 'i' kumari'.
S.PHON: ʔ iʔ minuwaħ kuʔ raħuwal ka qwalax ru βajħu ka tuɣal ini ɣa imaɣal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ riʔax ɣa βalaiq [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj ʔiʔ kumariʔ
S.TRANSL: 尤其在大雨或颱風過後三至五天，最適合灑網，

S.FORM: pakapayux ku' mananananaq ka inagal ka qulih.
pakapayux ku' mananananaq ka inagal ka qulih.
S.PHON: pakapajux kuʔ mananananaq ka inaɣal ka quliħ
S.TRANSL: 不僅魚獲量豐富種類也較多。

S.FORM: papatuwawun nku' Matu'uwal ga, paslahungun han ku' lahulahu ru pahangiqun la.
papatuwawun nku' Matu'uwal ga, paslahungun han ku' lahulahu ru pahangiqun la.
S.PHON: papatuwawun nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa pa[s|ɕ]laħuŋun ħan kuʔ laħulaħu ru paħaŋiqun la
S.TRANSL: 泰雅族的農耕先以焚墾再輪休山田為主，

S.FORM: tubuxan cu' turakis, pati' ru pumuwan cu' qatyai ru bunga'. mna'aring han ga pininangun ku' lahulahu han ru putungun ku' kahuniq la.
tubuxan cu' turakis, pati' ru pumuwan cu' qatyai ru bunga'. mna'aring han ga pininangun ku' lahulahu han ru putungun ku' kahuniq la.
S.PHON: tuβuxan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ turaki[s|ɕ] patiʔ ru pumuwan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qatjai ru βuŋaʔ mnaʔariŋ ħan ɣa pininaŋun kuʔ laħulaħu ħan ru putuŋun kuʔ kaħuniq la
S.TRANSL: 農作物以小米、陸稻、玉米和甘藷為主，先將開墾原始林後砍伐大樹，

S.FORM: lawaun cu' malngu' la ga gisiyagan la. naqru' 'i' gumisiyag la ga sicululing la. lawaun cu' qutux cu' ahangiqan han ru mna'aring 'i' gumilbak.
lawaun cu' malngu' la ga gisiyagan la. naqru' 'i' gumisiyag la ga sicululing la. lawaun cu' qutux cu' ahangiqan han ru mna'aring 'i' gumilbak.
S.PHON: lawaun [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ malŋuʔ la ɣa ɣi[s|ɕ]ijaɣan la naqruʔ ʔiʔ ɣumi[s|ɕ]ijaɣ la ɣa [s|ɕ]i[ʦ|ʨ]ululiŋ la lawaun [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ aħaŋiqan ħan ru mnaʔariŋ ʔiʔ ɣumilβak
S.TRANSL: 等到枯乾之後，闢除一定的範圍築出防火牆，然後放火燒山 ，約一星期後，

S.FORM: siutu' kahabag ku' ini kaculing ka kahuniq ru sihaga' kahabag ku' batunux.
siutu' kahabag ku' ini kaculing ka kahuniq ru sihaga' kahabag ku' batunux.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]iutuʔ kaħaβaɣ kuʔ ini ka[ʦ|ʨ]uliŋ ka kaħuniq ru [s|ɕ]iħaɣaʔ kaħaβaɣ kuʔ βatunux
S.TRANSL: 將焚墾後未燒盡的樹根或枝條堆置在田地周圍，並將田地整平或作成作成一坵一坵的田地，

S.FORM: tiku qabuli' na' kiman ru kahuniq niya' la ga balaiq 'i' matagaxiryu la.
tiku qabuli' na' kiman ru kahuniq niya' la ga balaiq 'i' matagaxiryu la.
S.PHON: tiku qaβuliʔ naʔ kiman ru kaħuniq nijaʔ la ɣa βalaiq ʔiʔ mataɣaxirju la
S.TRANSL: 燒後之草木作為灰肥，

S.FORM: lawaun tikay ru quminuwalax la ga mna'aring 'i' tumubux cu' turakis ru pati' ru mumuwa' cu' qatyai.
lawaun tikay ru quminuwalax la ga mna'aring 'i' tumubux cu' turakis ru pati' ru mumuwa' cu' qatyai.
S.PHON: lawaun tikaj ru quminuwalax la ɣa mnaʔariŋ ʔiʔ tumuβux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ turaki[s|ɕ] ru patiʔ ru mumuwaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qatjai
S.TRANSL: 下一場雨之後就開始播種，

S.FORM: 'i' kiya' na tikay a' mamayah ga, pumuwaan tikay cu' bunga' wiy. rahwal tikay ku' tinubuxan la ga lumacu' la.
'i' kiya' na tikay a' mamayah ga, pumuwaan tikay cu' bunga' wiy. rahwal tikay ku' tinubuxan la ga lumacu' la.
S.PHON: ʔiʔ kijaʔ na tikaj aʔ mamajaħ ɣa pumuwaan tikaj [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βuŋaʔ wij raħwal tikaj kuʔ tinuβuxan la ɣa luma[ʦ|ʨ]uʔ la
S.TRANSL: 若還有些耕地也種一些甘藷，當新禾出現時，

S.FORM: lawaun tikay lawiy ru makatatigalan ru makabuway. lawaun ru tayhuk cu' magalpug cu' qun cu' buwating la ga kalhul la.
lawaun tikay lawiy ru makatatigalan ru makabuway. lawaun ru tayhuk cu' magalpug cu' qun cu' buwating la ga kalhul la.
S.PHON: lawaun tikaj lawij ru makatatiɣalan ru makaβuwaj lawaun ru tajħuk [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ maɣalpuɣ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qun [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βuwatiŋ la ɣa kalħul la
S.TRANSL: 再開始拔草，直到11月稻穗成熟舉行收割祭，

S.FORM: mna'aring 'i' minang ru cumuling ru tubuxan la ru lahian 'i' makabuway ru kumlux ga, yani cubalay a' papatuwawun nku' Matu'uwal cubalay.
mna'aring 'i' minang ru cumuling ru tubuxan la ru lahian 'i' makabuway ru kumlux ga, yani cubalay a' papatuwawun nku' Matu'uwal cubalay.
S.PHON: mnaʔariŋ ʔiʔ minaŋ ru [ʦ|ʨ]umuliŋ ru tuβuxan la ru laħian ʔiʔ makaβuwaj ru kumlux ɣa jani [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj aʔ papatuwawun nkuʔ matuʔuwal [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj
S.TRANSL: 自焚墾整田播種到中耕再到最後的收割就是泰雅族人最典型的傳統生產方式之一。

S.FORM: mana'aring cucunga' ga, kiya' ku' manananaq na' gaga ka muwag cu' tawki' na' tomuk cku' qutux na' tinqalangan.
mana'aring cucunga' ga, kiya' ku' manananaq na' gaga ka muwag cu' tawki' na' tomuk cku' qutux na' tinqalangan.
S.PHON: manaʔariŋ [ʦ|ʨ]u[ʦ|ʨ]uŋaʔ ɣa kijaʔ kuʔ manananaq naʔ ɣaɣa ka muwaɣ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ tawkiʔ naʔ tomuk [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ qutux naʔ tinqalaŋan
S.TRANSL: 在很早以前，有一個部落存在著選舉頭目的文化，

S.FORM: capaang cubalay ku' tawki' na' tomuk ga, asiki kiya' ku' babalaiq na' inlungan, ini nahmuhmut maka'iwang 'i' kumal, ini nahmuhmut qumuriq cu' waw na' cuquliq,
capaang cubalay ku' tawki' na' tomuk ga, asiki kiya' ku' babalaiq na' inlungan, ini nahmuhmut maka'iwang 'i' kumal, ini nahmuhmut qumuriq cu' waw na' cuquliq,
S.PHON: [ʦ|ʨ]apaaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj kuʔ tawkiʔ naʔ tomuk ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki kijaʔ kuʔ βaβalaiq naʔ inluŋan ini naħmuħmut makaʔiwaŋ ʔiʔ kumal ini naħmuħmut qumuriq [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ waw naʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq
S.TRANSL: 說實在的，總頭目必須有善心，不胡亂欺騙別人，不偷竊，

S.FORM: ini nahmuhmut masa'ang cu' cuquliq. gumualu' cu' kanayril ru ulu'laqi', lungulungun ku' aruwa ka nanabakis. kiya' ku' inlungan niya' ka kinbalaiq 'i' musa' malahang ku' qutux ka tinqalangan.
ini nahmuhmut masa'ang cu' cuquliq. gumualu' cu' kanayril ru ulu'laqi', lungulungun ku' aruwa ka nanabakis. kiya' ku' inlungan niya' ka kinbalaiq 'i' musa' malahang ku' qutux ka tinqalangan.
S.PHON: ini naħmuħmut ma[s|ɕ]aʔaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq ɣumualuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kanajril ru uluʔlaqiʔ luŋuluŋun kuʔ aruwa ka nanaβaki[s|ɕ] kijaʔ kuʔ inluŋan nijaʔ ka kinβalaiq ʔiʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ malaħaŋ kuʔ qutux ka tinqalaŋan
S.TRANSL: 不隨便罵人， 關心妻子及小孩，回憶過逝的長者，他們的善心及於全部落族人，

S.FORM: baqun niya' ku' ima' ku' aqih ka cuquliq 'i' muwah 'i' humuwah ku' waw na' qutux na' tinqalangan.
baqun niya' ku' ima' ku' aqih ka cuquliq 'i' muwah 'i' humuwah ku' waw na' qutux na' tinqalangan.
S.PHON: βaqun nijaʔ kuʔ imaʔ kuʔ aqiħ ka [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq ʔiʔ muwaħ ʔiʔ ħumuwaħ kuʔ waw naʔ qutux naʔ tinqalaŋan
S.TRANSL: 他了解誰是惡者，將蓄意破壞部落。

S.FORM: kiya' ku' tawki' na' tomuk ku' qutux tinqalangan ta la ga,
kiya' ku' tawki' na' tomuk ku' qutux tinqalangan ta la ga,
S.PHON: kijaʔ kuʔ tawkiʔ naʔ tomuk kuʔ qutux tinqalaŋan ta la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 當部落有了總頭目，

S.FORM: kiya' ku' pacacpung cu' waw ka qutux tinqalangan ga pungan nku' cuquliq ku' kai' niya', galgan naha' matawaw wiy.
kiya' ku' pacacpung cu' waw ka qutux tinqalangan ga pungan nku' cuquliq ku' kai' niya', galgan naha' matawaw wiy.
S.PHON: kijaʔ kuʔ pa[ʦ|ʨ]a[ʦ|ʨ]puŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ waw ka qutux tinqalaŋan ɣa puŋan nkuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq kuʔ kaiʔ nijaʔ ɣalɣan naħaʔ matawaw wij
S.TRANSL: 他必須仲裁部落事務，族人則聽命於他並追隨他的腳步，

S.FORM: ana naha' kasa'ngangun 'i' hiya' ga, ini anabah masa'ang, ini ciyuk wiy.
ana naha' kasa'ngangun 'i' hiya' ga, ini anabah masa'ang, ini ciyuk wiy.
S.PHON: ana naħaʔ ka[s|ɕ]aʔŋaŋun ʔiʔ ħijaʔ ɣa ini anaβaħ ma[s|ɕ]aʔaŋ ini [ʦ|ʨ]ijuk wij
S.TRANSL: 不管人們如何責罵，他都不生氣也不回擊，

S.FORM: paca'ruxun naha' ku' tawki' na' tomuk ka gaga la ga, ma'usa' pakabalaiq ku' kinqiyanux na' tinqalangan nku' Matu'uwal la.
paca'ruxun naha' ku' tawki' na' tomuk ka gaga la ga, ma'usa' pakabalaiq ku' kinqiyanux na' tinqalangan nku' Matu'uwal la.
S.PHON: pa[ʦ|ʨ]aʔruxun naħaʔ kuʔ tawkiʔ naʔ tomuk ka ɣaɣa la ɣa maʔu[s|ɕ]aʔ pakaβalaiq kuʔ kinqijanux naʔ tinqalaŋan nkuʔ matuʔuwal la
S.TRANSL: 一旦建立良好的總頭目制度，泰雅族的部落才會有平靜的生活。

S.FORM: kakian nku' Matu'uwal ga, kiya' cku' ibabawiq ka ragiyax. kiya' wiy ku' payux ka pinumuwa' naha' i' kiya'.
kakian nku' Matu'uwal ga, kiya' cku' ibabawiq ka ragiyax. kiya' wiy ku' payux ka pinumuwa' naha' i' kiya'.

S.FORM: nanabakis i' cunga' ga, balaiq nku' Matu'uwal ku' tilubu' 'i' musa' 'i' sumbalaiq cu' kakanayril ini ga mamaliku ru manhahiyu 'i' makal na' lubu'.
nanabakis i' cunga' ga, balaiq nku' Matu'uwal ku' tilubu' 'i' musa' 'i' sumbalaiq cu' kakanayril ini ga mamaliku ru manhahiyu 'i' makal na' lubu'.
S.PHON: nanaβaki[s|ɕ] iʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uŋaʔ ɣa βalaiq nkuʔ matuʔuwal kuʔ tiluβuʔ ʔiʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ [s|ɕ]umβalaiq [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kakanajril ini ɣa mamaliku ru manħaħiju ʔiʔ makal naʔ luβuʔ
S.TRANSL: 傳統上泰雅人喜歡吹奏「口簧琴」來表達愛慕之意或宣洩情感，

S.FORM: ukas na ku' lubu' i' cunga' ga, wung! wung! maha' ku' hanang na' lubu' ga balaiq 'i' pungan cubalay.
ukas na ku' lubu' i' cunga' ga, wung! wung! maha' ku' hanang na' lubu' ga balaiq 'i' pungan cubalay.
S.PHON: uka[s|ɕ] na kuʔ luβuʔ iʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uŋaʔ ɣa wuŋ wuŋ maħaʔ kuʔ ħanaŋ naʔ luβuʔ ɣa βalaiq ʔiʔ puŋan [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj
S.TRANSL: 在往昔沒有其他樂器伴奏時，「口簧琴」的「嗡嗡」調子確實是原始且動人的。

S.FORM: asikina ga ini kapayux 'i' tilubu' ku' Matu'uwal ka hani la. kiya' tikay na ku' nabakis ka humaynas cku' maymal cu' kaal 'i' baq 'i' tilubu' na.
asikina ga ini kapayux 'i' tilubu' ku' Matu'uwal ka hani la. kiya' tikay na ku' nabakis ka humaynas cku' maymal cu' kaal 'i' baq 'i' tilubu' na.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]ikina ɣa ini kapajux ʔiʔ tiluβuʔ kuʔ matuʔuwal ka ħani la kijaʔ tikaj na kuʔ naβaki[s|ɕ] ka ħumajna[s|ɕ] [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ majmal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaal ʔiʔ βaq ʔiʔ tiluβuʔ na
S.TRANSL: 不過，目前能吹奏「口簧琴」的族人不多，五十歲以上的老者還存有一些，

S.FORM: ayhung cubalay san na' kinabahan nku' Matu'uwal ku' musa' 'i' makibaq cu' tilubu'.
ayhung cubalay san na' kinabahan nku' Matu'uwal ku' musa' 'i' makibaq cu' tilubu'.
S.PHON: ajħuŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj [s|ɕ]an naʔ kinaβaħan nkuʔ matuʔuwal kuʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ makiβaq [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ tiluβuʔ
S.TRANSL: 而年輕人認為學習吹「口簧琴」太難，

S.FORM: musa' 'i' sumbalaiq na' lubu' ku' kanayril ru maliku ga, asiga ini tatuhi' cuqang maha' ku' kinabahan nku' Matu'uwal.
musa' 'i' sumbalaiq na' lubu' ku' kanayril ru maliku ga, asiga ini tatuhi' cuqang maha' ku' kinabahan nku' Matu'uwal.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ [s|ɕ]umβalaiq naʔ luβuʔ kuʔ kanajril ru maliku ɣa a[s|ɕ]iɣa ini tatuħiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uqaŋ maħaʔ kuʔ kinaβaħan nkuʔ matuʔuwal
S.TRANSL: 用它來表達情意，也太間接了。

S.FORM: macka' cku' Itaal ku' Matu'uwal. imuwaag ga, gumlug cku' qutux cu' glug 'i' maqiyanux.
macka' cku' Itaal ku' Matu'uwal. imuwaag ga, gumlug cku' qutux cu' glug 'i' maqiyanux.
S.PHON: ma[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ itaal kuʔ matuʔuwal imuwaaɣ ɣa ɣumluɣ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ ɣluɣ ʔiʔ maqijanux
S.TRANSL: 汶水人就如同泰雅族一樣，認為家是共同生活的團體，

S.FORM: asiga qumaluwap, tumubun cu' nanabakis ini ga waw ka buwinah. ukas ku' maha' isu' nanaq asiki maglug ku' qutux cu' imuwaag.
asiga qumaluwap, tumubun cu' nanabakis ini ga waw ka buwinah. ukas ku' maha' isu' nanaq asiki maglug ku' qutux cu' imuwaag.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]iɣa qumaluwap tumuβun [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ nanaβaki[s|ɕ] ini ɣa waw ka βuwinaħ uka[s|ɕ] kuʔ maħaʔ i[s|ɕ]uʔ nanaq a[s|ɕ]iki maɣluɣ kuʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ
S.TRANSL: 舉凡狩獵、祭祀或其他活動，通常不以個人為單位而是以家為單位，

S.FORM: kiya' ku' maglug 'i' maqiyanux ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga san naha' maha' imuwaag. san nku' Matu'uwal maha' qutux cu' imuwaga ini ga qutux cu' naniqan.
kiya' ku' maglug 'i' maqiyanux ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga san naha' maha' imuwaag. san nku' Matu'uwal maha' qutux cu' imuwaga ini ga qutux cu' naniqan.
S.PHON: kijaʔ kuʔ maɣluɣ ʔiʔ maqijanux ka qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa [s|ɕ]an naħaʔ maħaʔ imuwaaɣ [s|ɕ]an nkuʔ matuʔuwal maħaʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaɣa ini ɣa qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ naniqan
S.TRANSL: 因此有所謂同住於一家屋之親族團體稱為「家庭」，汶水稱之為一家人或同一個餐廳。

S.FORM: imuwaag na' 'i' hiya' ga, kiya' 'i' yaba', yaya' ru matasasuway. mauwah 'i' tumuwang cku' imuwaag na' cuquliq ga iqat a' qutux cu' imuwaag.
imuwaag na' 'i' hiya' ga, kiya' 'i' yaba', yaya' ru matasasuway. mauwah 'i' tumuwang cku' imuwaag na' cuquliq ga iqat a' qutux cu' imuwaag.
S.PHON: imuwaaɣ naʔ ʔiʔ ħijaʔ ɣa kijaʔ ʔiʔ jaβaʔ jajaʔ ru mata[s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]uwaj mauwaħ ʔiʔ tumuwaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ imuwaaɣ naʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq ɣa iqat aʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ
S.TRANSL: 家由家長及子女組成，寄居不算家屬，

S.FORM: ukas wiy ku' ralu' na' imuwaag. pakaal ta' ku' ralu' ta' ga, asiki tuwangan ku' ralu' ni' yaba' ru yaya' su'.
ukas wiy ku' ralu' na' imuwaag. pakaal ta' ku' ralu' ta' ga, asiki tuwangan ku' ralu' ni' yaba' ru yaya' su'.
S.PHON: uka[s|ɕ] wij kuʔ raluʔ naʔ imuwaaɣ pakaal taʔ kuʔ raluʔ taʔ ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki tuwaŋan kuʔ raluʔ niʔ jaβaʔ ru jajaʔ [s|ɕ]uʔ
S.TRANSL: 家沒有可用來表示的姓，要表示個人時就在自己的名字後面加上父親或母親的名字，

S.FORM: yani capaang na' ralu' su'. imuwaag ga qutux cu' kinbakisan iqat a' kahabag.
yani capaang na' ralu' su'. imuwaag ga qutux cu' kinbakisan iqat a' kahabag.
S.PHON: jani [ʦ|ʨ]apaaŋ naʔ raluʔ [s|ɕ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kinβaki[s|ɕ]an iqat aʔ kaħaβaɣ
S.TRANSL: 家通常只有一代不是數代所組成，

S.FORM: ini pasasi'ahal ku' qumisuwan na' kanayril ru suway na' kanayril ini ga qumisuwan na' maliku ru suway na' maliku.
ini pasasi'ahal ku' qumisuwan na' kanayril ru suway na' kanayril ini ga qumisuwan na' maliku ru suway na' maliku.
S.PHON: ini pa[s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]iʔaħal kuʔ qumi[s|ɕ]uwan naʔ kanajril ru [s|ɕ]uwaj naʔ kanajril ini ɣa qumi[s|ɕ]uwan naʔ maliku ru [s|ɕ]uwaj naʔ maliku
S.TRANSL: 若未婚的姊妹或兄弟，

S.FORM: tayhuk cku' masasiahal ku' matasasuway la ga, asiki matagik cku' a'usa' niya' ka giqas ka imuwaag ini ga kabalay cu' giqas na' imuwaag nanaq.
tayhuk cku' masasiahal ku' matasasuway la ga, asiki matagik cku' a'usa' niya' ka giqas ka imuwaag ini ga kabalay cu' giqas na' imuwaag nanaq.
S.PHON: tajħuk [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ ma[s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]iaħal kuʔ mata[s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]uwaj la ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki mataɣik [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ aʔu[s|ɕ]aʔ nijaʔ ka ɣiqa[s|ɕ] ka imuwaaɣ ini ɣa kaβalaj [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ ɣiqa[s|ɕ] naʔ imuwaaɣ nanaq
S.TRANSL: 結婚後必須進入他家或興建房屋，家產，

S.FORM: tiku sinubilan na' rawrawq na' nanabakis ga, bali' wawaw nku' qumisuwan na' maliku kahabag waw nku' minasasuway kahabag ga.
tiku sinubilan na' rawrawq na' nanabakis ga, bali' wawaw nku' qumisuwan na' maliku kahabag waw nku' minasasuway kahabag ga.
S.PHON: tiku [s|ɕ]inuβilan naʔ rawrawq naʔ nanaβaki[s|ɕ] ɣa βaliʔ wawaw nkuʔ qumi[s|ɕ]uwan naʔ maliku kaħaβaɣ waw nkuʔ mina[s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]uwaj kaħaβaɣ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 非長子繼承而是由所有子女共同繼承。

S.FORM: talan nku' Matu'uwal ku' masiglug ga, magabatunux ku' kisiliq. asiki haynasun ku' pincapngan la ga, yani san maha' naqalun la ku' capaang na' rahwal na' waw la.
talan nku' Matu'uwal ku' masiglug ga, magabatunux ku' kisiliq. asiki haynasun ku' pincapngan la ga, yani san maha' naqalun la ku' capaang na' rahwal na' waw la.
S.PHON: talan nkuʔ matuʔuwal kuʔ ma[s|ɕ]iɣluɣ ɣa maɣaβatunux kuʔ ki[s|ɕ]iliq a[s|ɕ]iki ħajna[s|ɕ]un kuʔ pin[ʦ|ʨ]apŋan la ɣa jani [s|ɕ]an maħaʔ naqalun la kuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]apaaŋ naʔ raħwal naʔ waw la
S.TRANSL: 泰雅人視婚姻為神聖且須經過考驗才能完成的大事。

S.FORM: mhngiq ku' kakanayril ru mamaliku ga, maskakaru' cku' paysan ka waw ga pisaniq nku' Matu'uwal cubalay.
mhngiq ku' kakanayril ru mamaliku ga, maskakaru' cku' paysan ka waw ga pisaniq nku' Matu'uwal cubalay.
S.PHON: mħŋiq kuʔ kakanajril ru mamaliku ɣa ma[s|ɕ]kakaruʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ paj[s|ɕ]an ka waw ɣa pi[s|ɕ]aniq nkuʔ matuʔuwal [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj
S.TRANSL: 平時年輕男女在一起，以性為話題閒聊被當成是禁忌，

S.FORM: manahmuhmut 'i' tumimuk cku' kakanayril ku' mamaliku ga, asiki talan na' tomuk ru humibag cu' bawak ru maskakaru 'i' manubuwag ru tumubun cu' cuquliq maha' mnahuk kuwing cubalay.
manahmuhmut 'i' tumimuk cku' kakanayril ku' mamaliku ga, asiki talan na' tomuk ru humibag cu' bawak ru maskakaru 'i' manubuwag ru tumubun cu' cuquliq maha' mnahuk kuwing cubalay.
S.PHON: manaħmuħmut ʔiʔ tumimuk [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ kakanajril kuʔ mamaliku ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki talan naʔ tomuk ru ħumiβaɣ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βawak ru ma[s|ɕ]kakaru ʔiʔ manuβuwaɣ ru tumuβun [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq maħaʔ mnaħuk kuwiŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj
S.TRANSL: 如果男族人隨意挑逗，則需要在頭目見證下，殺豬設宴正式道歉。

S.FORM: marakyas ku' mamaliku ru kakanayril nku' Matu'uwal ga, rarasun nku' nanabakis ku' mamaliku ru kakanayril kahabag cku' imuwaag na' tomuk.
marakyas ku' mamaliku ru kakanayril nku' Matu'uwal ga, rarasun nku' nanabakis ku' mamaliku ru kakanayril kahabag cku' imuwaag na' tomuk.
S.PHON: marakja[s|ɕ] kuʔ mamaliku ru kakanajril nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa rara[s|ɕ]un nkuʔ nanaβaki[s|ɕ] kuʔ mamaliku ru kakanajril kaħaβaɣ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ imuwaaɣ naʔ tomuk
S.TRANSL: 男女族人在發育成年階段，族人便會集體帶至頭目家，

S.FORM: pincapngan na' humgub ku' gaga na' marakyas. mana'aring 'i' manubuwag, maquwas ru yugi'.
pincapngan na' humgub ku' gaga na' marakyas. mana'aring 'i' manubuwag, maquwas ru yugi'.
S.PHON: pin[ʦ|ʨ]apŋan naʔ ħumɣuβ kuʔ ɣaɣa naʔ marakja[s|ɕ] manaʔariŋ ʔiʔ manuβuwaɣ maquwa[s|ɕ] ru juɣiʔ
S.TRANSL: 並由巫師主持成年禮儀式，然後飲酒，歌舞狂歡，

S.FORM: muwani la ga, pakababaq ku' mamaliku' ru kakanayril ru maglug 'i' yugi'.
muwani la ga, pakababaq ku' mamaliku' ru kakanayril ru maglug 'i' yugi'.
S.PHON: muwani la ɣa pakaβaβaq kuʔ mamalikuʔ ru kakanajril ru maɣluɣ ʔiʔ juɣiʔ
S.TRANSL: 如此，男女也將會互相認識交誼一起共舞。

S.FORM: ini nata 'i' ragiyax ku' wagi' na ga, minamakarakyas ka mamaliku nku' Matu'uwal ga, rarima' musa' 'i' qumaluwap i' lahulahu, kakanayril na' 'i' hiya ga, tuminun i' imuwaag,
ini nata 'i' ragiyax ku' wagi' na ga, minamakarakyas ka mamaliku nku' Matu'uwal ga, rarima' musa' 'i' qumaluwap i' lahulahu, kakanayril na' 'i' hiya ga, tuminun i' imuwaag,
S.PHON: ini nata ʔiʔ raɣijax kuʔ waɣiʔ na ɣa minamakarakja[s|ɕ] ka mamaliku nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa rarimaʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ qumaluwap iʔ laħulaħu kakanajril naʔ ʔiʔ ħija ɣa tuminun iʔ imuwaaɣ
S.TRANSL: 第二天日出前，接受成年禮的男族人便上山打獵，（不過）女性則留在家中織布、

S.FORM: tumquwaw ru kabalay cu' tinabiq ru numaga' ku' siwaan niya' ka maliku 'i' muwah i' imuwaag.
tumquwaw ru kabalay cu' tinabiq ru numaga' ku' siwaan niya' ka maliku 'i' muwah i' imuwaag.
S.PHON: tumquwaw ru kaβalaj [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ tinaβiq ru numaɣaʔ kuʔ [s|ɕ]iwaan nijaʔ ka maliku ʔiʔ muwaħ iʔ imuwaaɣ
S.TRANSL: 釀酒與製作糕食等候心愛的人歸來，

S.FORM: babaw niya' la ga, mapanga' cu' qaqasinug ku' mamaliku la ga, yani cubaly san na' kakanayril maha' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah.
babaw niya' la ga, mapanga' cu' qaqasinug ku' mamaliku la ga, yani cubaly san na' kakanayril maha' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah.
S.PHON: βaβaw nijaʔ la ɣa mapaŋaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qaqa[s|ɕ]inuɣ kuʔ mamaliku la ɣa jani [ʦ|ʨ]uβalj [s|ɕ]an naʔ kakanajril maħaʔ muɣumalaq ka lawlawkaħ
S.TRANSL: 幾天後族人若扛獵物回來，就會被視為英雄，

S.FORM: humaynas wiy la ku' marakyas ka gaga la ga, balaiq 'i' masasi'ahag la.
humaynas wiy la ku' marakyas ka gaga la ga, balaiq 'i' masasi'ahag la.
S.PHON: ħumajna[s|ɕ] wij la kuʔ marakja[s|ɕ] ka ɣaɣa la ɣa βalaiq ʔiʔ ma[s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]iʔaħaɣ la
S.TRANSL: 也通過了成年禮的測驗，可以準備結婚事宜。

S.FORM: gaga nku' Matu'uwal ga macka' cku' Itaal. asiga mumuwa' cu' wawaw ru qumaluwap ka imuliq na' waw ga patuwawun nku' mamaliku,
gaga nku' Matu'uwal ga macka' cku' Itaal. asiga mumuwa' cu' wawaw ru qumaluwap ka imuliq na' waw ga patuwawun nku' mamaliku,
S.PHON: ɣaɣa nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa ma[ʦ|ʨ]kaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ itaal a[s|ɕ]iɣa mumuwaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ wawaw ru qumaluwap ka imuliq naʔ waw ɣa patuwawun nkuʔ mamaliku
S.TRANSL: 汶水泰雅人的社會規範如同泰雅族一樣，男生負責耕種、狩獵…等粗重工作，

S.FORM: kakanayril na' 'i' hiya' ga, matawaw cku' tuminun, malahang cku' imuwaag niya' ka lihika na' waw.
kakanayril na' 'i' hiya' ga, matawaw cku' tuminun, malahang cku' imuwaag niya' ka lihika na' waw.
S.PHON: kakanajril naʔ ʔiʔ ħijaʔ ɣa matawaw [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ tuminun malaħaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ imuwaaɣ nijaʔ ka liħika naʔ waw
S.TRANSL: 不過女孩，則負責織布、家計…等較輕鬆的工作，

S.FORM: ukas ku' capaang na' galgalgan nku' Matu'uwal. tiku ma'ubu' ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga, gumlug cku' gaga na' Matu'uwal.
ukas ku' capaang na' galgalgan nku' Matu'uwal. tiku ma'ubu' ka qutux cu' imuwaag ga, gumlug cku' gaga na' Matu'uwal.
S.PHON: uka[s|ɕ] kuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]apaaŋ naʔ ɣalɣalɣan nkuʔ matuʔuwal tiku maʔuβuʔ ka qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa ɣumluɣ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ ɣaɣa naʔ matuʔuwal
S.TRANSL: 汶水人無法律的觀念，複雜的家族是以所謂法律或規準來規範，

S.FORM: asiga kinqiyanux, sumnawaw ru gaga nku' qutux cu' imuwaag ga, yani ku' kai' nku' nanabakis ka aruwa' ku' galgalgan naha' cubalay.
asiga kinqiyanux, sumnawaw ru gaga nku' qutux cu' imuwaag ga, yani ku' kai' nku' nanabakis ka aruwa' ku' galgalgan naha' cubalay.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]iɣa kinqijanux [s|ɕ]umnawaw ru ɣaɣa nkuʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ ɣa jani kuʔ kaiʔ nkuʔ nanaβaki[s|ɕ] ka aruwaʔ kuʔ ɣalɣalɣan naħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj
S.TRANSL: 舉凡生活、信仰及社會體制的規準，就是祖先的遺訓。

S.FORM: san maha' qutux cu' glug ga, kiya' ku' qutux ka' sumnawaw naha' ka Utux na' Babaw na' Kaal.
san maha' qutux cu' glug ga, kiya' ku' qutux ka' sumnawaw naha' ka Utux na' Babaw na' Kaal.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]an maħaʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ ɣluɣ ɣa kijaʔ kuʔ qutux kaʔ [s|ɕ]umnawaw naħaʔ ka utux naʔ βaβaw naʔ kaal
S.TRANSL: 也就是說同一個團員之間的約束力來自於神靈的信仰，

S.FORM: masa'utu' kahabag ku' Utux na' Babaw na' Kaal ka hani ru inha' ga nanabakis ka aruwa'.
masa'utu' kahabag ku' Utux na' Babaw na' Kaal ka hani ru inha' ga nanabakis ka aruwa'.
S.PHON: ma[s|ɕ]aʔutuʔ kaħaβaɣ kuʔ utux naʔ βaβaw naʔ kaal ka ħani ru inħaʔ ɣa nanaβaki[s|ɕ] ka aruwaʔ
S.TRANSL: 神靈是由死去的祖先所組成，

S.FORM: tiku gaga na' galgalgan ru pisaniq ga, yani capaang na' kai' na' nanabakis ka aruwa'.
tiku gaga na' galgalgan ru pisaniq ga, yani capaang na' kai' na' nanabakis ka aruwa'.

S.FORM: capaang ka balaiq na' tatangaan ga, kabalay cku' ik na' tatangaan ku' lupung. mhngiq ga, balaiq'i' maniq cu' makilux ka naniqun.

S.TRANSL: 冬天來臨，擔任「衛兵」的族人，高高在上，風寒露濕，

S.FORM: tiku Itaal ga, paqasun naha' cubalay ku' inusa' naha' 'i' magalakam. kanayril ru ulu'laqi' ga, paqasun naha' wiy ku' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah ka minusa' 'i' magalakam.

S.PHON: tiku itaal ɣa paqa[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj kuʔ inu[s|ɕ]aʔ naħaʔ ʔiʔ maɣalakam kanajril ru uluʔlaqiʔ ɣa paqa[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ wij kuʔ muɣumalaq ka lawlawkaħ ka minu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ maɣalakam
S.TRANSL: 人莫不沈浸在勝利的喜悅中，婦人及孩童更為勇士的馘首成果歡欣鼓舞，

S.FORM: kiya' qutux ku' kanayril nku' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah ga, ini niya' tali' nanaq ku' maliku niya' nababalaiqun na' Itaal 'i' mital ku' tunux ka inaras naha' ru aqih gi maubu' cuqang la ru kahi naha' 'i' nauquun 'i' kumut nanaq ku' glug naha' la.

kiya' qutux ku' kanayril nku' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah ga, ini niya' tali' nanaq ku' maliku niya' nababalaiqun na' Itaal 'i' mital ku' tunux ka inaras naha' ru aqih gi maubu' cuqang la ru kahi naha' 'i' nauquun 'i' kumut nanaq ku' glug naha' la.
S.PHON: kijaʔ qutux kuʔ kanajril nkuʔ muɣumalaq ka lawlawkaħ ɣa ini nijaʔ taliʔ nanaq kuʔ maliku nijaʔ naβaβalaiqun naʔ itaal ʔiʔ mital kuʔ tunux ka inara[s|ɕ] naħaʔ ru aqiħ ɣi mauβuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uqaŋ la ru kaħi naħaʔ ʔiʔ nauquun ʔiʔ kumut nanaq kuʔ ɣluɣ naħaʔ la
S.TRANSL: 但在此時有一位勇士的妻子卻遍尋不著自己的丈夫。族人仔細清查獵回的頭顱，竟發現在激烈的戰鬥中，有人誤殺了自己部落中的勇士，

S.FORM: kanayril nku' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah ga, mingilis ru asi niya' gibai' ku' tunux na' maliku niya'.

S.PHON: kanajril nkuʔ muɣumalaq ka lawlawkaħ ɣa miŋili[s|ɕ] ru a[s|ɕ]i nijaʔ ɣiβaiʔ kuʔ tunux naʔ maliku nijaʔ
S.TRANSL: 勇士的妻子抱著頭顱痛哭失聲，

S.FORM: aqih a' kisiliq ru minglis ku' Itaal na' ga, kumaal ku' tawki' maha' babaw niya' 'i' musa 'i' magalakam lawiy ga, asiki patiqan ku' lihuw ru qangi nku' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah kahabag la.
aqih a' kisiliq ru minglis ku' Itaal na' ga, kumaal ku' tawki' maha' babaw niya' 'i' musa 'i' magalakam lawiy ga, asiki patiqan ku' lihuw ru qangi nku' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah kahabag la.
S.PHON: aqiħ aʔ ki[s|ɕ]iliq ru miŋli[s|ɕ] kuʔ itaal naʔ ɣa kumaal kuʔ tawkiʔ maħaʔ βaβaw nijaʔ ʔiʔ mu[s|ɕ]a ʔiʔ maɣalakam lawij ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki patiqan kuʔ liħuw ru qaŋi nkuʔ muɣumalaq ka lawlawkaħ kaħaβaɣ la
S.TRANSL: 當族人心中哀傷時，酋長做了決定：「以後出擊馘首時，每個勇士要用炭灰在額頭與下額抹黑，作為辨別，以防誤殺事件再發生。」

S.FORM: naki makababaq kahabag ku' mugumalaq ka lawlawkah la. naki ini nauqui' 'i' kumut ku' glug ta' nanaq.

S.TRANSL: 之後族人以此作為榮譽的象徵，要獲得紋面的封賜，

S.FORM: babaw niya' la ga kiya' la ku' patiqan ka gaga na' Itaal la. yani cubalay a' paqasun na' Itaal ku' patiqan la.

S.TRANSL: 之後族人以此作為榮譽的象徵，要獲得紋面的封賜，

S.FORM: wana makipatiqan su' ga, mamaliku na' 'i' hiya ga, asiki kuminut cu' tunux na' cuquliq ru kakanayril na' 'i' hiya' ga asiki baq 'i' tuminuk cu' siyatu' la ga, yani a' balaiq 'i' patiqan ku' raqinas naha' la.

wana makipatiqan su' ga, mamaliku na' 'i' hiya ga, asiki kuminut cu' tunux na' cuquliq ru kakanayril na' 'i' hiya' ga asiki baq 'i' tuminuk cu' siyatu' la ga, yani a' balaiq 'i' patiqan ku' raqinas naha' la.
S.PHON: wana makipatiqan [s|ɕ]uʔ ɣa mamaliku naʔ ʔiʔ ħija ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki kuminut [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ tunux naʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq ru kakanajril naʔ ʔiʔ ħijaʔ ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki βaq ʔiʔ tuminuk [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ [s|ɕ]ijatuʔ la ɣa jani aʔ βalaiq ʔiʔ patiqan kuʔ raqina[s|ɕ] naħaʔ la
S.TRANSL: 男子必須參加過馘首行動且實際有獵過人頭的記錄，而女子則需要有一手編織衣物的好功夫，才能在臉頰上紋面。

S.FORM: kiya' ku' tikay a' cinalxan ka sisiliq. tumaptap ku' pali' niya'. makahtu' cku' sug nku' kakabahniq ka ququququng ru manbahag i' babaw nku' batunux ka rahwal.
kiya' ku' tikay a' cinalxan ka sisiliq. tumaptap ku' pali' niya'. makahtu' cku' sug nku' kakabahniq ka ququququng ru manbahag i' babaw nku' batunux ka rahwal.

S.TRANSL: 有一種體型最小的sisiliq鳥，揮動著翅膀，從鳥群中後面小小的角落飛到巨石上，

S.PHON: pajux kuʔ kaβaħniq ka mital [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq ka ɣumawaħ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ kukuj nijaʔ ka ikħiʔ pa[s|ɕ]ijaqan kaħaβaɣ nkuʔ kakaβaħniq kuʔ [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq ka ħani
S.TRANSL: 眾鳥看到牠張開牠那小小的足爪及瘦如細枝的腿，引來四周鳥群的爆笑。

S.FORM: asikina ga, ini niya' kaaqih ku' pinasiya' nku' kakabahniq kahabag. matutuliq ku' sisiliq ru manbahag cku' babaw na' ubah na' batunux ka rahwal.
asikina ga, ini niya' kaaqih ku' pinasiya' nku' kakabahniq kahabag. matutuliq ku' sisiliq ru manbahag cku' babaw na' ubah na' batunux ka rahwal.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]ikina ɣa ini nijaʔ kaaqiħ kuʔ pina[s|ɕ]ijaʔ nkuʔ kakaβaħniq kaħaβaɣ matutuliq kuʔ [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq ru manβaħaɣ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ βaβaw naʔ uβaħ naʔ βatunux ka raħwal
S.TRANSL: 但是sisiliq鳥以謙恭的神色，穩重的心情，一點兒也不為嘲笑聲所擾，sisiliq提起雙爪，起身迅速朝向岩壁下處推動，

S.FORM: sirurwag niya' ku' batunux ka rahwal. mawiwi' ru mastataku' ku' rahwal ka batunx cku' yaik ka uqu' la.

S.PHON: [s|ɕ]irurwaɣ nijaʔ kuʔ βatunux ka raħwal mawiwiʔ ru ma[s|ɕ]tatakuʔ kuʔ raħwal ka βatunx [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ jaik ka uquʔ la
S.TRANSL: 巨石竟然翻滾起來，掉落到山谷下，

S.FORM: makabuway kahabag ku' rawiq nku' kabahniq 'i' mital ku' rahwal ka batunux 'i' mastataku' cku' yaik ka uqu'.

S.TRANSL: 群鳥直睜大眼睛，看著巨石翻落谷底的景像，

S.FORM: ukas a' sumnawaw kahabag maha' pagyani ru ukas tikay a' hanang.
ukas a' sumnawaw kahabag maha' pagyani ru ukas tikay a' hanang.

S.TRANSL: 沒有人相信會如此的鴉雀無聲。

S.FORM: babw niya' la ga, Utux san na' Itaal la ku' sisiliq. tiku sisiliq ka hani ga, bayqan cu' kisiliq na' Utux kahabag maha' laxi kahabag ku' aqih, agal kahabag ku' balaiq.
babw niya' la ga, Utux san na' Itaal la ku' sisiliq. tiku sisiliq ka hani ga, bayqan cu' kisiliq na' Utux kahabag maha' laxi kahabag ku' aqih, agal kahabag ku' balaiq.
S.PHON: βaβw nijaʔ la ɣa utux [s|ɕ]an naʔ itaal la kuʔ [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq tiku [s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]iliq ka ħani ɣa βajqan [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ ki[s|ɕ]iliq naʔ utux kaħaβaɣ maħaʔ laxi kaħaβaɣ kuʔ aqiħ aɣal kaħaβaɣ kuʔ βalaiq
S.TRANSL: 從此，sisiliq（綠繡眼）鳥，被泰雅族人封為鳥中之尊的靈鳥，神靈賦予為人類納吉避凶預兆旨示的代言者。

S.FORM: yani ku' cinapngan na' Itaal ka mausa' cku' Yaba' Utux Kaal.
yani ku' cinapngan na' Itaal ka mausa' cku' Yaba' Utux Kaal.

musa' 'i' matawaw cku' rahwal ka wawaw ku' Itaal ga, asiga mausa' malakam, qumaluwap, tumai', ini ga musa' 'i' tatuhi'.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ matawaw [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ raħwal ka wawaw kuʔ itaal ɣa a[s|ɕ]iɣa mau[s|ɕ]aʔ malakam qumaluwap tumaiʔ ini ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ tatuħiʔ
S.TRANSL: 泰雅族人從事部落重大事務，不管是出草祭團、狩獵行動、提親還是遠行等等，

S.FORM: asiki paqucan han ku' kabahniq na' Utux. babaw niya' la ga yani ku' san na' Itaal maha' aqih a' kabahniq.
asiki paqucan han ku' kabahniq na' Utux. babaw niya' la ga yani ku' san na' Itaal maha' aqih a' kabahniq.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]iki paqu[ʦ|ʨ]an ħan kuʔ kaβaħniq naʔ utux βaβaw nijaʔ la ɣa jani kuʔ [s|ɕ]an naʔ itaal maħaʔ aqiħ aʔ kaβaħniq

S.FORM: qutux cu' kaal ka tatubunan nku' Matu'uwal ga maglug 'i' tumubun kahabag.
qutux cu' kaal ka tatubunan nku' Matu'uwal ga maglug 'i' tumubun kahabag.
S.PHON: qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaal ka tatuβunan nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa maɣluɣ ʔiʔ tumuβun kaħaβaɣ
S.TRANSL: 汶水人的歲時祭儀以共同參與為主，參與的團體通常以血緣為主，

S.FORM: tiku maglug 'i' tumubun kahabag ga yani ku' matakaqutux cu' imuwaag. maglug cku' qutux ka gaga ka pisaniq.
tiku maglug 'i' tumubun kahabag ga yani ku' matakaqutux cu' imuwaag. maglug cku' qutux ka gaga ka pisaniq.
S.PHON: tiku maɣluɣ ʔiʔ tumuβun kaħaβaɣ ɣa jani kuʔ matakaqutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ imuwaaɣ maɣluɣ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ qutux ka ɣaɣa ka pi[s|ɕ]aniq
S.TRANSL: 共同遵守同一習慣與禁忌，

S.FORM: ini packa ku' kinrahwal ru kintikay niya'. mahananu ga matakaqutux cu' qalang mahananu ga maglug kahabag ku' matakaqutux cu' qalang.

S.PHON: ini pa[ʦ|ʨ]ka kuʔ kinraħwal ru kintikaj nijaʔ maħananu ɣa matakaqutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qalaŋ maħananu ɣa maɣluɣ kaħaβaɣ kuʔ matakaqutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qalaŋ
S.TRANSL: 規模大小不一，有時一個部落一個祭團，有時數個部落共同舉行，

S.FORM: tiku hani ga minuwah kahabag cku' wawaw na' pintuwawan.
tiku hani ga minuwah kahabag cku' wawaw na' pintuwawan.
S.PHON: tiku ħani ɣa minuwaħ kaħaβaɣ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ wawaw naʔ pintuwawan
S.TRANSL: 基本上皆與農事有關。

S.FORM: qutux cu' kaal ga, qutux ini ga usayng cu' buwating ga minang ru tumubun cu' Yaba' Utux kaal. tugal cu' buwating ka makapahpah a' nabughug, qaym ru pilikaway la ga,

S.PHON: qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaal ɣa qutux ini ɣa u[s|ɕ]ajŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βuwatiŋ ɣa minaŋ ru tumuβun [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ jaβaʔ utux kaal tuɣal [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βuwatiŋ ka makapaħpaħ aʔ naβuɣħuɣ qajm ru pilikawaj la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 每年一、二月是開墾並舉行開墾祭，三月梅、桃李初開，

S.FORM: makaal ku' tinqalangan kahabag ru muwag cu' qutux cu' ri'ax 'i' sumi'atu' ru babaw niya' la ga tiputing 'i' tumubux cu' turakis ru pati'.
makaal ku' tinqalangan kahabag ru muwag cu' qutux cu' ri'ax 'i' sumi'atu' ru babaw niya' la ga tiputing 'i' tumubux cu' turakis ru pati'.
S.PHON: makaal kuʔ tinqalaŋan kaħaβaɣ ru muwaɣ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ riʔax ʔiʔ [s|ɕ]umiʔatuʔ ru βaβaw nijaʔ la ɣa tiputiŋ ʔiʔ tumuβux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ turaki[s|ɕ] ru patiʔ
S.TRANSL: 全部落討論新春開工的時間，隨後並播種小米和稻，

S.FORM: humbu' tikay la ku' pinumuwa' ga, lahian la. lawaun tikay ru lahian lawiy.
humbu' tikay la ku' pinumuwa' ga, lahian la. lawaun tikay ru lahian lawiy.
S.PHON: ħumβuʔ tikaj la kuʔ pinumuwaʔ ɣa laħian la lawaun tikaj ru laħian lawij
S.TRANSL: 當作物發芽則開始除草（祭），

S.FORM: mana'aring i' sapat cu' buwating ru mamaqisu' cu' buwating ru tayhuk i' magalpu' cu' qun ka makabuway ku' pinumuwa' la ga kalhul la.
mana'aring i' sapat cu' buwating ru mamaqisu' cu' buwating ru tayhuk i' magalpu' cu' qun ka makabuway ku' pinumuwa' la ga kalhul la.
S.PHON: manaʔariŋ iʔ [s|ɕ]apat [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βuwatiŋ ru mamaqi[s|ɕ]uʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βuwatiŋ ru tajħuk iʔ maɣalpuʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qun ka makaβuwaj kuʔ pinumuwaʔ la ɣa kalħul la
S.TRANSL: 從四月到九月再到十月，除草再除草，

S.FORM: naqru' ku' waw ka kalhul la ga situbun naha' ka' kinluh la. naqru' 'i' kumluh la ga, pugian han ru marngu' ku' pinumuwa' la ga sirahgun cku' aqhul la.
naqru' ku' waw ka kalhul la ga situbun naha' ka' kinluh la. naqru' 'i' kumluh la ga, pugian han ru marngu' ku' pinumuwa' la ga sirahgun cku' aqhul la.
S.PHON: naqruʔ kuʔ waw ka kalħul la ɣa [s|ɕ]ituβun naħaʔ kaʔ kinluħ la naqruʔ ʔiʔ kumluħ la ɣa puɣian ħan ru marŋuʔ kuʔ pinumuwaʔ la ɣa [s|ɕ]iraħɣun [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ aqħul la
S.TRANSL: 田中稻穗已開始成熟，收割工作一結束就舉行豐年祭，結束之後將農作物曬乾收藏至穀倉內，

S.FORM: situbun naha' ku' pintuwawan naha' kahabag la. babaw ka kaal cku' giqas ka qutux cu' buwating la ga wawahan ku' yakhul ru situbun naha' ku' Yaba' Utux kaal.
situbun naha' ku' pintuwawan naha' kahabag la. babaw ka kaal cku' giqas ka qutux cu' buwating la ga wawahan ku' yakhul ru situbun naha' ku' Yaba' Utux kaal.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]ituβun naħaʔ kuʔ pintuwawan naħaʔ kaħaβaɣ la βaβaw ka kaal [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ ɣiqa[s|ɕ] ka qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βuwatiŋ la ɣa wawaħan kuʔ jakħul ru [s|ɕ]ituβun naħaʔ kuʔ jaβaʔ utux kaal
S.TRANSL: 並舉行收藏祭，直到次年的第一個月打開穀倉並舉行開倉祭。

S.FORM: qutux cu' kaal ka tatubunan nku' Matu'uwal ga, maglug cku' Yaba' Utux Kaal.
qutux cu' kaal ka tatubunan nku' Matu'uwal ga, maglug cku' Yaba' Utux Kaal.
S.PHON: qutux [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ kaal ka tatuβunan nkuʔ matuʔuwal ɣa maɣluɣ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ jaβaʔ utux kaal
S.TRANSL: 汶水人的歲時祭儀基本上與泰雅族人的祖靈崇拜有關，

S.FORM: yani ku' situbun cku' Yaba' Utux Kaal maha' naki araruwa' 'i' balaiq ku' kinqiyanux nku' kinabahan ru balaiq ku' pintuwawan kahabag.

S.FORM: manamanama' 'i' muhngiq i' imuwaag ru malahang cku' gaga ka hani. tiku magalaying ka gaga ka pisaniq ga, ini pasihriq i' imuwaag, ini usa' 'i' maqilaap i' imuwaag na' cuquliq ru ini usa' maskakaru' i' imuwaag na' cuquliq wiy.

manamanama' 'i' muhngiq i' imuwaag ru malahang cku' gaga ka hani. tiku magalaying ka gaga ka pisaniq ga, ini pasihriq i' imuwaag, ini usa' 'i' maqilaap i' imuwaag na' cuquliq ru ini usa' maskakaru' i' imuwaag na' cuquliq wiy.
S.PHON: manamanamaʔ ʔiʔ muħŋiq iʔ imuwaaɣ ru malaħaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ ɣaɣa ka ħani tiku maɣalajiŋ ka ɣaɣa ka pi[s|ɕ]aniq ɣa ini pa[s|ɕ]iħriq iʔ imuwaaɣ ini u[s|ɕ]aʔ ʔiʔ maqilaap iʔ imuwaaɣ naʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq ru ini u[s|ɕ]aʔ ma[s|ɕ]kakaruʔ iʔ imuwaaɣ naʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq wij
S.TRANSL: 首要的禁忌是家裡不爭吵，既不能到別人家睡覺也不能到別人家聊天。

S.FORM: tiku tiputing ka gaga ka pisaniq ga, ini bi'ing cu' qaraqarax na' tatinun ku' kakanayril, ini bi'ing cu' buli' ru ragum ku' mamaliku.
tiku tiputing ka gaga ka pisaniq ga, ini bi'ing cu' qaraqarax na' tatinun ku' kakanayril, ini bi'ing cu' buli' ru ragum ku' mamaliku.
S.PHON: tiku tiputiŋ ka ɣaɣa ka pi[s|ɕ]aniq ɣa ini βiʔiŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ qaraqarax naʔ tatinun kuʔ kakanajril ini βiʔiŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ βuliʔ ru raɣum kuʔ mamaliku
S.TRANSL: 次要的禁忌是女孩不觸碰織布用具，男孩則不能拿刀和針。

S.FORM: tiku tiputing lawiy ka gaga ka pisaniq ga, ini nahmuhmut kabawax cu' pinaylag na' hapuniq na' cuquliq, ini paglug 'i' maniq cku' buwinah na' naniqan, ini papabayq cu' naniqun wiy.
tiku tiputing lawiy ka gaga ka pisaniq ga, ini nahmuhmut kabawax cu' pinaylag na' hapuniq na' cuquliq, ini paglug 'i' maniq cku' buwinah na' naniqan, ini papabayq cu' naniqun wiy.
S.PHON: tiku tiputiŋ lawij ka ɣaɣa ka pi[s|ɕ]aniq ɣa ini naħmuħmut kaβawax [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ pinajlaɣ naʔ ħapuniq naʔ [ʦ|ʨ]uquliq ini paɣluɣ ʔiʔ maniq [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ βuwinaħ naʔ naniqan ini papaβajq [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ naniqun wij
S.TRANSL: 第三個禁忌是絕不能與鄰居借火，更不能與別人共餐或提供別人食物。

S.FORM: tapaputing cubalay ka gaga ka pisaniq ga, ini bi'ing cu' cacapuh, ini capuh i' imuwaag wiy.

S.PHON: tapaputiŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uβalaj ka ɣaɣa ka pi[s|ɕ]aniq ɣa ini βiʔiŋ [ʦ|ʨ]uʔ [ʦ|ʨ]a[ʦ|ʨ]apuħ ini [ʦ|ʨ]apuħ iʔ imuwaaɣ wij
S.TRANSL: 最後一個禁忌是絕不能拿掃把掃地。

S.FORM: galgan ta' kahabag ku' gaga ka hani la ga, babaw niya' la ga, pahbuw ku' turakis ru ma'usa' balaiq ku' naniqun ta' ka qutux cu' imuwaag la.
